predictions.selection_reason: user-controlled data-youtube and data-ytparams attributes -> innerHTML assignment -> potential XSS via iframe src injection
predictions.source_summary: id from elem.getAttribute('data-youtube'), youtubeParams from elem.getAttribute('data-ytparams') - both HTML attributes controlled by page content/developers
predictions.sink_summary: innerHTML assignment creating iframe with dynamically constructed src attribute
predictions.guard_summary: Only checks if youtubeParams starts with '&' (regAmp=/^&/), no validation/sanitization of id or youtubeParams values
predictions.risk_pattern: User/developer-controlled HTML attributes directly concatenated into iframe src URL parameters without validation, then assigned via innerHTML
enclosing_conditions: if(youtubeParams && !regAmp.test(youtubeParams)) - only adds '&' prefix if missing
predictions.context_summary: YouTube video embed handler that constructs iframe src from template URL with user-provided video ID and parameters
unresolved_facts: Whether YouTube's embed domain restricts malicious parameter values
Whether the hosting page sanitizes data-youtube/data-ytparams attributes before setting them
